                                        ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1 & B1-
2 Neighborhood Shopping Districts, B2-1.5 & B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use Districts,
C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District, RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District, RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District, symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 8-H in the area bound by:

      a line 75 feet west of and parallel to the alley next west of and parallel to South Damen
      Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to South Archer Avenue; a line 130 feet north
      of and parallel to West 35'^ Street; South Damen Avenue; the alley next north of and
      parallel to West 35"^ Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Wood Street; a
      line 73 feet north of and parallel to West 35"" Street; South Wood Street;,the alley next
      north of and parallel to West 35'^ Street; a line 144 feet east of and parallel to South
      Marshfield Avenue; West 35'^ Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Ashland
      Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West        Street; a line 72 feet east of and
      parallel to South Wood Street; West 35'^ Street; South Honore Street; the alley next
      south of and parallel to West 35'^ Street; South Wolcott Avenue; West 35"^ Street; South
      Winchester Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 35'^ Street; a line 36 feet
      west of and parallel to South Winchester Avenue; West 35"^ Street; a line 96 feet east of
      and parallel to South Damen Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West
      Street; South Damen Avenue; and West 35'^' Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
